subject: Round-2 spec review: FAIL, 7 blocking open
body: I re-reviewed the revised spec independently: checked all 16 round-1 findings against the live spec text, re-read 25 citations the revision added or changed, and ran /sc:spec-panel-armb (critique, requirements and architecture) in re-review mode as review 2 of 3. Six of the eight round-1 blocking findings are resolved; F1 stays open because adversarial nests its status under return_contract, so WC-5 reports a successful run as failed and the step-4 check raises KeyError, and F3 stays open because the adversarial Phase 0 smoke run has no expected report path. Five new blocking findings were introduced or exposed by the revision: cli-portify's dry_run is unmapped, the universal contract path contradicts 8 section-3 rows, an unattended implement overwrites the workflow package's contract and breaks the D2(a) resume, WC-3's new no-ask rule contradicts D2(b) and pr-submit, and AC-1.2 passes --output to workflow and init-lite. Citations: 2 wrong line or step numbers, both minor. Verdict FAIL; one fix cycle remains before escalation, and the Reviser brief is in the report.
